title: Commonwealth Electoral Amendment (Banning Dirty Donations) Bill 2022
short_title: Commonwealth Electoral Amendment (Banning Dirty Donations) Bill 2022

summary.attribution: Written by a model from the explanatory memorandum; not the record
sentences: The bill would ban political donations from certain industries and cap other donations at $3,000 per election term.
It would prohibit donations from the fossil fuel, property development, tobacco, banking, liquor and gambling, and pharmaceutical industries, as well as their representative organisations.
The definition of 'gift' would be expanded to cover membership fees, subscription fees and payments to attend fundraising events.
changes: Imposes a $3,000 cumulative donation limit per election term.
Broadens the definition of 'gift' to include fees for memberships, subscriptions and fundraising events.
summary.affected: Political parties, candidates, associated entities, and donors from the banned industries and other sources.
